t: A set of Ugly Christmas Armor
This delightfully tacky Holiday-themed armor comes in 2 colors but can be mixed and matched. $(br2)Hats and Sweaters (Helmets and Chestplates) have a chance to drop from Mobs that are wearing it.
这套风格浮夸、主题鲜明的节日盔甲提供两种配色，且可自由混搭。$(br2)帽子与毛衣（头盔与胸甲）有一定几率由穿戴该盔甲的怪物掉落。

The armor has several tiers and can be upgraded using a Smithing Table.$(br2)$(li)Tier 1 (Leather): crafted or obtained by drop $(li)Tier 2 (Iron): upgraded in Smithing Table $(li)Tier 3 (Diamond): upgraded in Smithing Table $(li)Tier 4 (Netherite): upgraded in Smithing Table
该盔甲分为多个阶段，可通过锻造台进行升级。$(br2)$(li)阶段1（皮革）：通过合成或掉落获得 $(li)阶段2（铁）：于锻造台升级 $(li)阶段3（钻石）：于锻造台升级 $(li)阶段4（下界合金）：于锻造台升级
